patch_description: Keep direct-demand rewards as the dominant signal, while adding a modest reward when two selected links form a two-hop route for a demand pair. This gives the QUBO some awareness of traffic that can be served indirectly without letting the two-hop approximation overwhelm the baseline that already performs well. A small endpoint-throughput contribution also favors links connected to nodes with substantial traffic. The quadratic-term count is at most \(n(n-1)(n-2)\), within the stated limit.
